diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references
null_resource.wait_for_cluster already references aws_eks_cluster.this[0].endpoint in its provisioner environment, so its explicit dependency on aws_eks_cluster.this duplicates implicit ordering.

null_resource.wait_for_cluster can run its endpoint health check before aws_security_group_rule.cluster_private_access permits access. For a private-only endpoint this can cause the readiness provisioner to time out; order the check after this ingress rule.

aws_autoscaling_group.workers launches nodes without waiting for workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy. The role reference does not ensure its required EKS permissions have been attached before bootstrap.
aws_autoscaling_group.workers launches nodes without waiting for workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy. When this attachment is enabled, networking permissions should be installed before node bootstrap.
aws_autoscaling_group.workers launches nodes without waiting for workers_AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly, allowing bootstrap image pulls to race installation of registry permissions.

aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template launches nodes without waiting for workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy. Referencing the instance profile does not ensure EKS permissions are attached before bootstrap.
aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template launches nodes without waiting for workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy. When enabled, this attachment supplies networking permissions needed at bootstrap.
aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch nodes before workers_AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly is attached, causing bootstrap image pulls to race registry authorization.
